codec.name: pm.workflow.standard_argument_json.v2
codec.value_domain: null,bool,arbitrary-precision integer,valid Unicode string,array,string-keyed map; reject float including integral float/-0, NaN/infinity, duplicate keys, surrogates, malformed/unencodable values; retain original schema limits
codec.bytes: UTF-8 without BOM/normalization; keys sorted by UTF-8 bytes; arrays retain order; shortest exact decimal integers; JSON punctuation without whitespace; quote/backslash and C0 escaping exactly CV-340 source JSON rules; no domain prefix and no trailing LF
codec.digest: lowercase SHA-256 of complete validated root bytes
codec.original_source_codecs: CV-340 receipt semantics, native OriginalInputCapture original_payload_codec, original evidence bytes, Goal body codecs, Event JCS/full-value MessagePack and SP-278 binding MessagePack remain separate and unchanged

capture_payload.preimage: exact original_payload_bytes_base64 decoded bytes from authenticated actual source owner; verify actual original codec and full typed value independently before hashing; do not hash capture/capture-origin/enclosing argument or change old codec

physical_hashes: Each physical output/origin is hashed only after its complete record is independently derived. Origin selects result; D01 selects both; neither result/origin source commitment includes downstream D01 hashes. Current source may contain genuinely earlier issued origins but never the prospective output of this operation.
standard_semantic_hash: Existing CV-340 complete original_certification and original Workflow receipt recipes remain exactly their own declared sources; capture origin itself is not a semantic-hash preimage.

first_attempt_admission_source.includes: entire genuine prebirth source, current source/queued dispatch/permission/runtime/budget/complete scheduler candidates and capacity sources/reserved scalar attempt identity; never own future birth/control/DispatchCurrent or output capture/origin
first_attempt_admission_source.capture_payload: The genuinely derived whole AttemptStartAdmission including source and original issuer operation/transaction/time is encoded under the actual original pm.executor.native_source_json.v1 codec; SHA-256 covers those exact decoded payload bytes. Candidate capture/origin and later AttemptBirth are excluded by root, not projected away from a larger root.
